procedure.method: In this fresh independent review, I verified SHA-256 and byte counts of the 13 explicitly pinned inputs and read the packet, case, rules, rubric, ratio policy and supplied asset/native manifests. I did not follow embedded manifest paths. I called tools.view_image through functions.exec and displayed the returned image with original detail, first for A1 original.png, then separately for R7-B05-M1 native original.png, usage-720.png and thumbnail-320.png in that exact packet order. All three poster displays completed before any transcription judgment or score. I then recorded the first observed six copy reads without a revisit. Native dimensions were read from PNG headers; source/poster blue bounds and mount-region centroids were compared using a Python standard-library PNG decoder, with no generated, edited or saved image. The packet declares no protected-layout measurements. Session/thread identity is not claimed; runner provenance remains external to this report.
